record.description_evidence:
Turn any photo into the photo you actually wanted — just by typing. Say goodbye to ordinary photo editors, and hello to Editable: the AI photo editor that listens. A different outfit, a new background, a polished headshot, a pose you couldn't get on camera, a blurry shot you wish was sharp — describe it, tap once, and watch it happen.

REALISTIC AI EDITS THAT NO ONE CAN TELL

If you're expecting heavy filters or an obvious AI overlay, think again. Editable doesn't paste effects on top of your picture — it reimagines the photo itself, keeping you looking like you, only better. Smooth skin that keeps your freckles. A pose you didn't think to strike. Every result is a natural, finished photo — so real that even you won't believe AI did the job.

NOT YOUR REGULAR PHOTO EDITING APP

You don't think in sliders — you think in sentences. "Make the light warmer." "Smooth my skin but keep my freckles." "Swap this jacket for a navy blazer." Editable understands what you're asking for and returns a natural, finished result. Keep it, or refine it with another prompt until it's exactly right.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

Open a photo. Type the edit. See your result in seconds. No tutorials, no filter hunting, no design skills. Just say what you want — Editable does the rest.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH EDITABLE

- AI Pose Generator: Strike the pose after the shot — the angle, the energy, the attitude
- 4K Upscale: Sharpen, unblur, and enlarge any photo up to 4K — old photos, low-light shots, screenshots
- AI Reframe: Wrong framing? Zoom out, recenter, or open up the scene — after the photo is taken
- AI Skin Retouch: Even skin tone, fewer blemishes and acne, zero plastic look — retouching by sentence, not by slider
- AI Headshots: Type the role, get the shot — business-ready portraits for work profiles, resumes, and dating apps
- AI Outfit Try-On: Type a look like "navy blazer, white shirt, dark jeans" and see yourself in it
- AI Couple Photos: Merge two photos into one realistic shared scene
- Magic Cleanup: Remove bystanders, watermarks, or anything unwanted — AI fills in what was behind
- AI Color Grading: Grade with a prompt, or fine-tune warmth, contrast, saturation, and grain
- Trend Generators: Action figures, anime, instant-film throwbacks, 90s yearbook, baby photos — refreshed weekly

EDITABLE IS PERFECT FOR

Selfies that finally look like you on your best day
Professional profile pictures and resumes
Dating photos that feel natural, not staged
Social posts, short videos, and stories
Anyone tired of retaking the same photo twenty times

SHARE EVERY PHOTO FEARLESSLY

Every pose? Post-ready. Every picture? Absolute charm. And when the edit is the story, share the whole transformation as a short video — original to final, edit by edit. Built for social feeds and short-form video.

WHY EDITABLE?

One prompt-edit core powers everything: poses, headshots, upscaling, retouching, cleanup, trends. Stack edits one prompt at a time — Anime → Instant film → Warm grade — until the photo feels like yours. And the Explore library keeps growing: Hand-Drawn Anime, Pet Portrait, Cyberpunk, Watercolor, Pixel Art, 3D Doll and more.

START WITH CREDITS

Every new user starts with credits — enough to try prompt editing, 4K upscale, headshots, and trend templates before choosing a plan.

We'd love your feedback — reach us at rayinformatics.com.

Download Editable now and turn your first photo into the photo you wanted — in under 30 seconds.

record.name: Retouch Photo - Remove Objects
record.offering: Photo & Video app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Tired of being photobombed? Thinking about getting rid of some imperfections in the background of the photo but don’t know how? Need to erase unwanted objects from your pictures to get them just right? All these annoying things shouldn’t be a problem anymore with our AI-driven photo editor. RetouchAI is that magic button that will help you easily transform poorly taken photos into the ones you actually deserve.


User-friendly interface, comprehensible functionality, the capability to remove imperfections in “one-click” are features that RetouchAI offers for you, specifically:


• People auto-detection

RetouchAI offers you highly convenient tools to identify strangers and crowd. The editor will precisely auto-detect the borders and highlight them for further auto removal. You just need to single them out in one tap


• Imperfections removal
• Lines removal
• Blemish removal

The app declutters photo imperfections and retouches them in an extremely simplified, yet smart way. The editor makes sure that the chosen area is erased without the photo distortion and is repaired appropriately.

• Multiple retouch algorithms

Once you select a particular area in your photo that needs to be restored, the app will offer you multiple variants. You may choose the one that looks the most natural and will be the best fit.


• Background edit

With the RetouchAI photo editor background replacement feature, you can cut out the existing background of your photo easily and replace it with one of the templates from the gallery. In case you don’t want to change the background, the app provides you with the convenient functionality to blur the background to the required extent. 


• Efficient clone stamp tool

When you erase certain objects from the photo, the editor needs to restore the marked area with correctly chosen colors. This is done via the clone stamp tool that uses the surrounding area as a context to restore the photo precisely.


• Teeth whitening

The tool allows you to whiten your teeth and make your smile even more fabulous than it is now. Everything is simple: select the necessary area, adjust the intensity of the brush, and boom, everything is ready. Explore a natural teeth whitening feature now. 


• Stretching

Allows you to modify the selected area both vertically and horizontally. It's no longer a problem to increase your height, enlarge your hips, or adjust anything else. You just need to choose the place you need to stretch and modify it to the extent you want.

• Helpful tooltips & friendly support

Despite being rather intuitively obvious, the app has numerous embedded tooltips that pop up once you start using the photo editor. All the tooltips were designed to make your photo editing process seamless and pleasant so that you say goodbye to sophisticated interfaces, confusing buttons, and annoying welcome tutorials.


Download RetouchAI and make your photos great again. Enjoy!


Don’t forget to check our privacy policy and terms of service:

http://retouch-ai.com/privacy-policy.html
http://retouch-ai.com/terms-of-service.html

• Subscription for Retouch AI for full access to all features.

• Subscription length: one week, one month, 12 months and lifetime.

• Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase.

• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.

• Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

• The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.

• When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.

• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

AI Photo Editor – Transform Photos with AI Magic
Bring your photos to life with the power of artificial intelligence. AI Photo Editor uses advanced image-to-image AI technology to transform your photos with realistic, high-quality results. Change outfits, replace backgrounds, restyle portraits, or apply creative effects using simple text descriptions or curated ideas—no editing experience required. Create professional-looking photo edits in seconds. Whether you are enhancing a profile picture, experimenting with fashion styles, or creating eye-catching social media content, AI Photo Editor delivers fast, powerful, and visually stunning results.

KEY FEATURES
AI-Powered Image-to-Image Transformations: Transform your photos using text prompts powered by modern AI image generation. Describe what you want—such as a formal suit, beach background, sunglasses, cinematic lighting, or artistic style—and let AI intelligently reimagine your image while preserving facial details and realism.
Quick Ideas by Category: Browse hundreds of ready-made AI prompts organized into intuitive categories including Outfits & Clothing, Hair & Beard Styles, Accessories, Backgrounds, Effects & Lighting, and Creative Styles.
Before & After Comparison: Instantly compare your original image with the AI-generated result side by side to see the transformation clearly.
High-Quality AI Results: Generate sharp, realistic, and visually appealing images using advanced AI image-to-image processing designed for portraits, fashion, and creative edits.
Save and Share Easily: Save your creations to your photo gallery or share them directly on social media platforms.

FLEXIBLE CREDIT SYSTEM
Start with 4 free credits on first launch. Watch ads to earn 2 free credits daily. Upgrade to Pro for extended creativity and uninterrupted editing.

PRO SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
Choose a plan that fits your needs. The Weekly Plan is perfect for short-term projects, while the Monthly Plan offers the best value for regular users. Pro benefits include 20 credits daily with automatic refills, unlimited AI photo transformations, an ad-free experience, priority AI processing, and the flexibility to cancel anytime.

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
Your privacy is important. Photos are processed securely and are never stored. Images are used only to generate the transformation you request and are not reused or shared.

PERFECT FOR
Social media content creators, fashion experimentation, profile picture upgrades, creative photo editing, professional portraits, and fun photo transformations with friends and family.

HOW IT WORKS
Upload your photo. Describe your idea or choose a preset. Let AI transform your image. Compare, save, and share.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage or cancel your subscription in Account Settings after purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/hhiosapp/privacy-policy

record.description_evidence:
Your photo, edited the way you describe it. Change a background, remove a distraction, or create a new look with AI Image Editor & Enhancer.

START WITH A PHOTO. ADD YOUR IDEA.
Choose a photo and describe what you want to change. The AI works from your image, so you can refine a picture you already love without learning complicated editing tools.

MAKE THE CHANGES THAT MATTER
• Remove unwanted objects or people from the background.
• Reimagine a setting or give your photo a different background.
• Adjust colors, lighting, and the mood of an image.
• Explore a new visual style with your own instructions.
• Enhance detail and increase image resolution with Pro.

KEEP REFINING
Compare the original with your result, add another edit, or return to an earlier version. Your original stays unchanged. Find previous edits in History and mark your favorites.

SAVE YOUR RESULT
Save to Photos or Files, or share directly from the app. Free saves include the app's watermark; Pro saves do not.

AI editing requires an internet connection. Results vary with the photo and instructions.

MONTHLY PRO SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is an optional, auto-renewing monthly subscription for more AI edits, image enhancement, and watermark-free saves. The local price is shown in the app before purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase confirmation, except during an eligible free trial. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before that period ends. PHOTO EDITOR THAT EASILY MAKES YOUR PHOTOS LOOK AMAZING
Adobe Lightroom’s one-tap features like Quick Actions and Adaptive Presets let you retouch and enhance photo quality in seconds. These AI photo editor tools suggest the best edits for your images. REMOVE DISTRACTIONS AND BLUR BACKGROUND
Adobe Lightroom gives you professional photo editing tools that are easy to use. Blur the photo background for a polished look, adjust finer details, or use AI Generative Remove as an object eraser in photos.

POWERFUL EDITS WITH ZERO HASSLE
Use photo lighting tools to tweak exposure, highlights, and shadows. Fix photos with presets, photo effects, color grading, hue, saturation, or add a blurry bokeh effect to match your vibe.

- RESTORE: Old photographs are usually low-quality and lacking definition, even more so if time has spoiled them. Our AI can restore them to increase a lot their quality and definition and make them look like taken with a modern expensive camera.
